body: Thanks for connecting, Dana. I applied for the Backend Engineer, Payments role at Northwind Pay on 20 September. The recurring card mandates part of the post is close to my work at Tidewater Freight, where I led the mandate retry service in Go. Are you the right person to ask about it? If someone else is, a name is plenty.

R1.text: Northwind Pay job post, Backend Engineer, Payments, posted 2026-09-12. Meet the hiring team: Dana Cruz, Talent Partner. Requirements: recurring card mandates, Go, Postgres.

profile_facts.P1: 4 years building Go payment services at Tidewater Freight.
profile_facts.P2: Led the mandate retry service at Tidewater Freight, about 1 million requests per day.
profile_facts.P4: Applied to Northwind Pay Backend Engineer, Payments on 20 September 2026.
profile_facts.P5: Fixed a retry storm behind a slow partner bank in 2025 with per-bank retry budgets; duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3.
